scenarios.name: combat-damage-locks-the-damaged-player-out-of-lifegain
scenarios.why: Stigma Lasher's combat damage to p1 fires its DamageDone ability, whose Effect carries RememberObjects$ TriggeredTarget -- the damaged player (CR 121.6: the remembered player rides the trigger into the Effect). The registered CantGainLife static's Player.IsRemembered clause then replaces p1's Revitalize gain (CR 614.1) with nothing, so p1 stays at 18; the only life movement is Lasher's 2 combat damage.
